Data Engineering Leader with 14+ years of experience designing, modernizing and operating large-scale enterprise data platforms across Snowflake and Azure environments.
Strong architectural and operational depth in Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), large-scale data migration (500+ TB), RBAC implementation, masking policies and performance optimization.
Experienced in managing distributed data engineering teams (25+ members), driving SLA adherence, code and design reviews, batch optimization and cross- functional stakeholder alignment.
Proven ability to bridge business requirements with scalable technical implementation while maintaining data integrity, governance and cost control.
Led multi-year US onsite engagements with major insurance and retail clients, collaborating with Marketing, Finance, R&D & Operations stakeholders to build domain-aligned data solutions.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
ACCENTURE SERVICES PVT. LTD.
July 2011 – Present
Solution Tech Architect / Data Engineering Lead
IBM Netezza → Snowflake Migration | US Retail Client (Los Angeles) | Jul 2024 – Present
Designed end-to-end Snowflake data platform architecture using Azure Data
Lake (Bronze) and Snowflake (Silver/Gold).
Built ingestion framework using StreamSets to load data from databases, files,
real-time feeds and Hadoop sources into Azure.

Implemented incremental ingestion logic (SCD Type 2) for maintaining historical accuracy.
Led migration of ~560TB historical data using Azure Data Box and metadata-
driven delta synchronization.
Structured Snowflake environments (Dev, Pre-Prod, Prod) with controlled
warehouse sizing per workload.

Implemented RBAC and column-level masking policies to secure PII data.
Optimized long-running batch jobs through SQL profiling and warehouse
resizing.
Designed metadata-based validation approach using analytical comparisons
(min/max/sum/avg) to ensure data consistency.
Coordinated onshore and offshore teams to ensure delivery reliability and SLA
adherence.
Associate Manager / Data Engineering Lead
Enterprise Data Engineering Release | Nov 2022 – Jun 2024
Led distributed data engineering
team delivering Snowflake-based
enhancements.
Reviewed ETL design and transformation logic to ensure performance and
scalability.
Defined job-level SLA monitoring and failure escalation protocols.

Introduced structured JIRA tracking to improve delivery transparency.

Improved batch performance through SQL optimization before scaling compute.
Team Leader – Snowflake Migration
Dec 2020 – Oct 2022
Designed target-state architecture for IBM DB2 → Snowflake migration.
Established data modeling standards and enforced surrogate key integrity.

Implemented warehouse usage segregation (small for business users, medium/large for batch jobs).
Defined performance thresholds and investigated execution variance across
jobs.
Earlier Roles (2011 – 2020)
Senior Software Engineer / Application Development Analyst 
Developed enterprise-scale ETL pipelines using Informatica.
Built data marts supporting analytics and reporting workloads.
Automated Unix-based batch processing frameworks.
Provided production support and release management.
LEADERSHIP s IMPACT
Managed 25+ data engineers across ETL, batch and validation streams. 
Restructured team assignments based on performance tracking.
Reduced batch inefficiencies through structured profiling and targeted
optimizations.

Implemented masking governance checklist to prevent unauthorized PII exposure.
Ensured 95%+ job success rate across migration pipelines.
